title: That's Too Easy (LeBron)
blurb: No celebration, no gloating, just a flat observation about the size of the gap in ability. LeBron James dismissing something other people find genuinely difficult is the low-effort flex in its purest form, with the added advantage of being demonstrably true when he says it. Play it after solving something trivially. Better still, play it ironically, straight after barely surviving something extremely hard that visibly cost you everything you had. The second usage is where most of the comedy lives, and it is where most people end up.
origin: LeBron James's viral 'that's too easy' dismissal.
